I've logged somewhere close to 1000 hours on this before finding it on steam. The online community is hit or miss, but the single player campaign is fantastic. Get a couple of friends, and get ready to fight for that last .001 of a second so you can win. Stupid physics, stupid speeds, fucking amazing fun levels.

Let me get this straight, the game itself isn't bad, it's the online that really bugs me. You have to spectate one in every five games unless you pay £20. You can't play with friends either. Or go on certain servers.

It's so restricted that it's probably worth paying a fiver or so and getting trackmania 2 stadium or canyon as you will be able to play without the annoying restrictions.

It says in the game description that it's a 'truly free to play game'. It just isn't.

Some limitations with the free acount, but there is a lot of customizability with the car appearance wise (not model-wise). If you want a realistic racing experience, this is not it. Also theres a more traditional single player. Cheers to TrackMania.
